page.notes: Long s is printed as s and has been normalised to s. The catchword "losophiæ" completes the hyphenated "Phi-" at the end of the text. "densitas" is doubtful: the scan is faint, so the reading is marked [?]. Printed spelling is kept throughout, e.g. "Aristoteles", "Categorijs", "siccitate", "secundo". Words split across lines without a printed hyphen (temperamen/tum, nun/cupantur, ma/teriam) are joined whole. No signature is printed.
